svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 160 x 300 mm, 3 mm aluminium. Front view is the face the box sits on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Heights from the bottom edge; sideways from the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Window 100 x 150 mm, 6 mm corners, 75 to 225 mm up: drill the corners

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 mm, cut between with a jigsaw, file straight. It saves weight.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Band slots 3 x 15 mm at 66 mm each side, centred 17 and 283 mm up:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: chain drill 3 mm and file square. The bands pass through these.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lug screws 5.5 mm at 62 mm each side, 41 and 259 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: V-saddle screws 4.5 mm on the centre line, 42, 62, 238 and 258 mm up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: countersink from the front so the screw heads sit flush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every hole and edge; round the corners to about 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: V-saddles on the back, the enclosure on the front between the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bands; each band crosses the front above or below the box.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay the saddles and lugs on it and look through each hole.
